annotations.title: Your games, and what’s yours to read

description: The signed-in person’s games: the ones they own (claimed here, or on their Roblox account or its groups), hold a seat on, or reach through their studio team. Each with its universe id, name, players now, their role on it, whether Roblox’s own analytics are connected for them (only those have private numbers) and whether its Robux are theirs to read. Start here before my_game_numbers, my_game_days or my_game_sources.
